jobs.name: s12_spray
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) at the pharmacy counter has just handed a customer a throat spray and now gently shows a small plain box of throat lozenges beside it, with a friendly open-palm gesture; the customer, calm and open, looks at it with interest. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels, price tags or text of any kind anywhere in the image; boxes and bottles are plain and unlabeled.
jobs.meaning: пример: к спрею от горла — пастилки с антисептиком, «Показать?»
